text:
- **Owner questions and replies:** Ask-tool questions now get answers on the site as well as in chat. Only the first answer counts, and owner replies reach a session by push alone.
- **Agent check reliability:** The AGENTS.md check now gives the same verdict on every rerun. Pull request checks run faster, and full grading runs daily on main.
- **Repo tooling:** This repo now pins a newer pm release, and its service runs that release. Claude Code auto memory is off here, and pm no longer installs a git hook.
- **Test suite stability:** `make test-go` passes on every run now. The service end-to-end test takes a free port from the kernel, not a shared one.
